about: Channels the channel scout watches: apps, social platforms, forums, communities, newsletters, podcasts, marketplaces and ad networks where GolfPrice AI could spread the word. status: "watch" (rising, check again), "try" (on the ideas board for John), "on" (we're there), "skip" (not for us, with why). The scout updates this every fortnight; John approves anything that costs money or his time.

channels.name: AppLovin Ads
channels.kind: ad network (ads inside mobile games and apps)
channels.why: Opened its self-serve ads platform to all advertisers in 2026 and growing fast; built for advertisers with return-on-ad-spend data.
channels.fit: Not yet: paid, needs our own conversion data first, and some retailer programmes restrict paid traffic. Possible later angle: Wild Nine ads inside mobile games.

history.note: No change: still no conversion data of our own to judge a paid test.

channels.name: YouTube Shorts series (seasons and episodes)
channels.kind: feature on a platform we use
channels.why: Rolled out to creators on 23 Sep 2026: Shorts grouped into seasons and episodes with custom thumbnails and sequential playback. YouTube says microdramas passed 6.5bn views in H1 2026, and 40% of their views came more than 30 days after upload.
channels.fit: Strong: The Fourball is already a numbered weekly series. Free; a minute of setup per episode at most.

channels.name: Bluesky
channels.why: We already post there. Similarweb (via TechCrunch, Aug 2026): mobile MAU 10.4m in June 2026, down 27.2% year on year.
channels.fit: Keep it automated and cheap; don't add effort while usage shrinks.

channels.name: Threads
channels.why: Sources disagree: Similarweb via TechCrunch says mobile DAU up 21.3% to 147m (July 2026); Apptopia says DAU fell eight months running (May 2026).
channels.fit: Possible cheap cross-post from Instagram later; not until the picture is clearer.

channels.name: Instagram carousels: a caption per slide, up to 20 slides
channels.kind: feature on a platform we use
channels.why: Per-slide captions added June 2026, on top of the 20-slide limit.
channels.fit: Our carousels and Myth or Mulligan can carry a short searchable line per slide.

channels.name: Instagram Features (long horizontal video) and Series
channels.kind: feature on a platform we use
channels.why: Announced 26 Oct 2026; tests in the US and Brazil only. Episodic Reels 'Series' testing in the US, India and Mexico since spring.
channels.fit: Series would suit The Fourball once it reaches the UK; Features (long video) doesn't fit us.

channels.name: TikTok AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
channels.kind: feature on a platform we use
channels.why: Announced 5 Oct 2026 (US article; UK not mentioned).
channels.fit: Built for sellers with TikTok Shop, not comparison sites. Watch for any affiliate or creator angle in the UK.

channels.name: WhatsApp Channels
channels.why: Updates tab used by 1.5bn people daily (Meta, via Search Engine Land); WhatsApp reaches 92% of UK online adult smartphone users (Ofcom data, via Sprout Social).
channels.fit: A free channel for the weekly Fourball and one honest price check. We already have WhatsApp share buttons; wait for evidence that our visitors share there.

channels.name: HowDidiDo and intelligentgolf (with Pin Vision GPS)
channels.why: July 2026 partnership adds live GPS to the apps; the Play listing claims 1m+ golfers across 2,000+ UK and Irish clubs.
channels.fit: Where club golfers already score. No public partner or listing programme found; the society connector could ask about one for Society HQ.

channels.name: Garmin Golf API
channels.why: Select partners only, licence fee applies.
channels.fit: Costs money and isn't open to us.

channels.name: Reddit r/golf and r/GolfUK
channels.why: r/golf near 1m members (2024 figure); rules ban solicitation and spam; marketing 'largely frowned upon'. The common 9:1 norm caps self-promotion at about 10%.
channels.fit: Only as a genuine, disclosed member answering kit and price questions, which costs John regular time. Never drop links.

channels.name: Golf Monthly forum
channels.why: Spam and adverts mean an immediate permanent ban.
channels.fit: Not for promotion. Fine for John personally as a disclosed member, nothing more.

channels.name: Golf Discord servers
channels.why: Typical rules (e.g. Broken Tee Society) allow promotion only in a 'promote your stuff' channel with staff permission.
channels.fit: Low effort if a UK server has a promo channel; games like Wild Nine fit. Disclose, use the right channel, once.

channels.name: Indoor golf and simulator venues
channels.why: Caddi Club calls itself England's largest indoor network: four London venues, 3,000+ active golfers, two new venues a year planned. Industry estimate: about 1,200 UK indoor venues.
channels.fit: Winter-league societies could use Society HQ and the live scorecard. A partnership costs John's time: one for the society connector to research.

channels.name: ChatGPT Shopping (merchant programme)
channels.why: Live for US users; merchants apply to a waitlist; ranking favours 'the maker or primary seller', and no rules for comparison sites are published. ChatGPT Ads reached the UK in June 2026 (vendor source).
channels.fit: Not a listing route for a comparison site yet. Our route stays AI-readable pages (quick-answers idea). Ads are paid: John's budget only.

channels.name: HotUKDeals (golf tag)
channels.why: Golf tag busy in the Black Friday 2026 sale.
channels.fit: We must not post our own links. Watch what golfers vote up as a demand signal; check its posting rules before anything else.

channels.name: Fast-growing golf YouTube channels
channels.why: MyGolfSpy ranked channels by 365-day view growth (e.g. Grant Horvat +121%); mostly US and the data is from 2025.
channels.fit: Press desk route only (data and games, never paid). Need UK-focused, recent growth data first.

channels.name: Pinterest
channels.why: MAU up 11% to 640m (Q2 2026, vendor summary of company figures).
channels.fit: Already on the board as 'shorts-pinterest' (parked low).
